pageview_metric: Monthly all-access user views for exact article title; redirects not rolled up
tree_neighbors: Most 12-month views when complete, otherwise global in-degree
network_metric: PageRank on the directed selected-article hyperlink graph

enrichment.community_method: Louvain on undirected projection; resolution=1; random seed=401
enrichment.betweenness_method: Directed normalized approximation using 32 uniformly sampled sources; seed=401
enrichment.depth_method: Directed BFS from article 1164; empty depth means unreachable
enrichment.source_depth_warning: Original depth represents selection tiers, not shortest hyperlink distance
enrichment.source_community_warning: Original community is assigned TF-IDF subtopic, not detected graph community
